required_checks: derives alerts only from configured canonical or registered sources
preserves source provenance and chain/network identity
supports severity thresholds and delivery-channel selection
implements rate limits and abuse controls
marks reorged/reverted/superseded presentation events without rewriting finalized history
survives restart without duplicate user-visible delivery
notification delivery failure does not affect underlying protocol state

privacy_checks: no private Messenger or Commons payload indexing
authority_checks: notification action buttons only hand off to Wallet/origin app authorization
